heading: Account Settings

danger.cardDescription: Once you deactivate your account, you will not be able to log in again. This action can be reversed by contacting support.
danger.confirmDescription: This will soft-delete your account and blacklist your access token. You will be logged out immediately and will not be able to sign in again unless support reactivates your account.
